The work focuses on regulating reasoning by manipulating the model's internal states through looping, implicitly generating latent thoughts, which matches 'internal_state_level' targeting internal states for reasoning regulation, distinct from token-level interventions.

The looping mechanism enables progressive refinement of implicit reasoning through iterative updates across loops, akin to step-by-step internalization, though it is more architectural than training-based.
